body:
Anonymous clean-checkout proof completed 2026-07-28 against public github.com/7thsense/fireweed tag v0.23.2.

## Blocker clearance
- Prior external blocker ("Current main must be published...") is obsolete.
- Repo visibility=public (GitHub API anonymous HTTP 200).
- Release v0.23.2 published 2026-07-28T21:04:39Z (non-draft).
- Anonymous: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git -c credential.helper= clone --depth 1 --branch v0.23.2 https://github.com/7thsense/fireweed.git
- Resolved revision c0f6566d6028c4ae33f4d8ec9cdcddd84d0274b5; scripts/ci/public-release-gate.py present.

## Platform / tools
- Linux sindri 6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2 x86_64
- rust-toolchain.toml channel 1.92.0 (rustc 1.92.0, cargo 1.92.0 via rustup)
- redis-cli 8.8.0, cmake 4.4.0, gitleaks 8.30.1, cargo-deny 0.19.0
- No private credentials (credential.helper empty; GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN unset)
- CARGO_TARGET_DIR under clone only (not maintainer tree)

## Commands and results
1. rustup run 1.92.0 cargo check -p fireweed → exit 0 (~32s). fireweed v0.23.2 Finished dev profile.
2. README quickstart memory backends on 127.0.0.1:18080 → service "fireweed-service 0.23.2 listening"; PING=PONG; XADD item; XREADGROUP returned item; XACK=1; XLEN=0; ~105s including cold compile. Manual interventions: none.
3. git diff --check on pristine tag tree → exit 0.
4. python3 scripts/ci/public-release-gate.py (published lock) → PASSED=false; first failure functional-format-identity (cargo fmt --check diff at crates/fireweed-server/src/lib.rs:6736 extra blank line). Separately, cargo check --locked also fails because Cargo.lock still lists workspace crates at 0.23.1 while Cargo.toml is 0.23.2.

## AC mapping
1. Fresh public checkout completes README quickstart without private access: YES. Full release-readiness gate on the published tag: NO (fmt + lock drift on v0.23.2 tree). Operator-directed close criterion (anonymous clone + cargo check -p fireweed) met.
2. Evidence records revision, platform, tools, duration, commands: YES (this note + bead evidence).
3. No undocumented manual step or maintainer credential: YES for clone/check/quickstart.
4. git diff --check: YES on pristine tag.

## Residual (not closing criteria for this attempt)
- Land fmt fix for fireweed-server/src/lib.rs and Cargo.lock workspace version refresh on main so public-release-gate.py is green for the next tag.
summary: Anonymous public clone v0.23.2: cargo check -p fireweed + README quickstart pass; release-gate blocked by published fmt/lock drift
